R1 Claude @3ff87e4 (comprehensive; round-trip contract VERIFIED SOUND — one PUT constructor; a11y/palette clean): P2 zero-dose+time phantom timing, P2 split-dose copy collapse, P3 sticky re-visit, P3 degraded library render, P3 negative-dose clamp -> ALL FIXED d7c08ee (incl. self-found '+time chip on none-today row' hole + copy-strip belt-and-suspenders). R2 Codex @3ff87e4: P1 copy-yesterday races date navigation, P2 addProductRow stale snapshot, P2 absence-only untracked sections invisible -> ALL FIXED 2484b65 (viewedDateRef guards both paths w/ null sentinel; functional appends; SECTION_ABSENCE_KEYS visibility). Codex security @3ff87e4: NO FINDINGS. R3 (P1 rule full re-run @2484b65): Claude — fixes compose correctly, ref commit-to-effect window analyzed and PROVEN HARMLESS (load-reset), one P2 remaining = the PRE-EXISTING CopyDayButton path missing the same guard, fix prescribed in-lane -> APPLIED e638ee1 (one line + page test, mutation-verified; note: the first application was lost to a codex workspace-write scan resetting the worktree mid-run — recorded as a process lesson — and cleanly re-applied after the scan). Codex review @2484b65: three library-staleness P2s (stale GET clobbers fresh create; degraded-state drop after create — convergent w/ Claude P3; sub-0.001 step rounding) -> RECORDED-AND-DEFERRED to issue #170 per the convergence discipline (rare paths, need a deliberate state-model refactor). Codex security @2484b65: NO FINDINGS ('every daily-log PUT path submits complete form state containing section_absences'); it examined the copy-day race and rejected it as pre-existing/no attacker boundary — fixed here anyway. Final head e638ee1: 361 vitest / 46 files, 17 playwright, cold-cache lint/format/build all 0.
